hypothesis: On an Intel Arc Pro B60 (Xe2) under Mesa ANV 26.0.8, dev chooses GPU-only buffers' memory type from the property flags alone, which picks type 0 (CCS-compressed, kept for images); buffers do not take it, so vkc_init fails and qwen36's dense chain stays off without a message, one GPU job per matrix. Choosing memory types among those the buffers take (memoryTypeBits), and pinning subgroups of 16 on Xe2 (at the reported 32 the chain's routed experts are wrong), starts the chain out of the box: decode several times faster, with the same greedy answers.
